backup.restore_point: PENDING_FRESH_BACKUP: stamp with scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs right before the apply
backup.production_rule: Two follow-ups, no table, column, row or ACL change. (a) The four-argument staff_decline_direct_booking_v1 (cf_confirm_flow) also declines a booking the hold sweep marked expired when a reason_code event is already on file for it (booking_lifecycle_events.after_state has the key reason_code); a retry on such a row posts no second guest notice; every other status is refused exactly as before; same signature, security definer, empty search_path, grants restated (authenticated only). (b) inventory_purchases.purchased_at defaults to public.manila_today() instead of CURRENT_DATE (UTC); the receipt RPCs still pass coalesce(p_purchased_at, current_date) themselves and are NOT changed (their md5 is pinned by s132 to s134).
backup.notes: Apply after cf_confirm_flow (20261205000000) is applied (the guard raises 55000 otherwise). No begin/commit in the file: the runner wraps it with the ledger row. Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour) and source.commit to the reviewed head. No app push is needed: Staff 3.4.53 and later already call the decline.

forward_verification.name: decline_gate_is_s136_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '7cf6e1a294db9ede851253de7c93f4f9' from pg_proc p where p.oid = to_regprocedure('public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text,text)')

forward_verification.name: decline_gate_is_security_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc p where p.oid = to_regprocedure('public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text,text)')

forward_verification.name: decline_grants_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text,text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: three_argument_wrapper_untouched
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_decline_direct_booking_v1(uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and (select count(*) = 2 from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = 'staff_decline_direct_booking_v1')

forward_verification.name: purchases_default_is_manila_today
forward_verification.query: select (select pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid) from pg_attrdef ad join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = ad.adrelid and a.attnum = ad.adnum where ad.adrelid = 'public.inventory_purchases'::regclass and a.attname = 'purchased_at') ~* 'manila_today' and (select pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid) from pg_attrdef ad join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = ad.adrelid and a.attnum = ad.adnum where ad.adrelid = 'public.inventory_purchases'::regclass and a.attname = 'purchased_at') !~* 'current_date'

accepted_failing_tests.note: Baseline of a --no-acl restore of the production backup (DATA: the copy lacks the rows the suite expects; ACL: the copy lacks the grants). Each fails identically on a scratch DB without this release. Any failure outside these numbers stops the release. Copied from the s134 contract; re-measure on the rehearsal copy.

rollback.safe_until: Any time. The rollback puts the cf_confirm_flow four-argument decline body back (md5 42905864d5b773d0503a2e518ec26a50) and the CURRENT_DATE default of inventory_purchases.purchased_at; rows written meanwhile keep their dates and decisions.
